latency_methodology.retrieval: Hybrid retrieval is executed once per question. Its measured latency is shared across configurations.
latency_methodology.reranker: Includes pair construction, CrossEncoder prediction and sorting for the selected candidate pool.
latency_methodology.total: Measured hybrid retrieval latency plus the corresponding reranker stage latency.
latency_methodology.execution_order: Candidate-pool execution order is rotated between questions to reduce systematic order effects.
latency_methodology.warmup: Optional warm-up runs are excluded from measured evaluation results and latency statistics.
